groq._visionNote: The camera's fast rung (camera/GroqVision, ~1.4 s on the A20e), hedged with the Gemini vision model (VisionLadder.race, 23 Oct 2026): a question, money or a follow-up starts both and prefers Gemini's answer within camera.vision.smartWaitMs; a plain description asks Gemini only when Groq is slow or fails. Each image counts ~2k input tokens from the planner's daily budget.

speech._note: B-18: provider ids per role, tried in order; the phone's engine is always the last resort. Twi goes to the UG HCI Lab gateway (language.json hcilab_asr / hcilab_tts) when its token is in local.properties and its quota lasts; English stays on the phone. Owner, 16 Oct 2026 (morning): the Khaya web platform (khaya_web_asr / khaya_web_tts, the owner's new key) was the backup behind the HCI Lab. Owner, 17 Oct 2026 (final): the owner chose the lab's ASR and TTS — Twi hearing and voice are the HCI Lab's ONLY (the hackathon bars ready-made Ghanaian ASR/TTS from other institutions; the Khaya hearing/voice clients are disabled). Earlier, 17 Oct: option 2 — the lab's VOICE is first again (3.7 s on 16 Oct, recorded clips play at once), hearing stays Khaya's (lab ASR 37–63% word errors vs Khaya 28–44% on the owner's recordings); Khaya voice is the backup. Owner, 16 Oct 2026 (later): "pause the lab key … focus on the new one" — Twi is Khaya only; to bring the lab back put hcilab_asr / hcilab_tts first in these lists (its clients and token are untouched).

tts._twiNote: 29 Oct 2026: the HCI Lab first and alone online (ttsHedgeMs 0); our Space voice only when it fails; the phone's own Twi voice offline (OfflineFirstTts). Before — 21 Oct 2026 (owner: 'I'll use the online side … keep the space warm because I feel like it's faster'): our Space's Twi voice first, the HCI Lab's second (ttsHedgeMs), the phone's own Twi voice when offline (OfflineFirstTts).
tts._ghEnglishNote: 29 Oct 2026 (owner chose Gemini's Kore voice): the FIRST network voice here that is configured speaks English replies — gemini_tts when local.properties has SPEECH_GEMINI_TTS_KEY, else Kafui Dey on our Space. RoutingTts: sentence by sentence, the first within speech.ghEnglish.firstWaitMs, else the english chain (the phone's own Kafui voice, the system engine) says it and the network voice rests; offline it is never asked. Before — 19 Oct 2026: 19 Oct 2026: English replies in Kafui Dey's voice from the language Space first (RoutingTts: sentence by sentence, the first within speech.ghEnglish.firstWaitMs); the english chain above when it is off (speech.ghEnglish.enabled=false), offline, resting or slow. Twi lines keep their English pieces on the english chain unless speech.ghEnglish.inTwiLines=true.
tts._kusNote: 19 Oct 2026 (owner: Kusaal is the main language): kusvoice = the Kusaal v3 Space voice on the phone (sherpa-onnx, assets/models/ondevice/kus/tts, 114 MB, offline). A line it cannot say goes to the English voice (RoutingTts others) — never silent.

speech._ttsHedgeNote: 29 Oct 2026 (owner: online Twi is the HCI Lab's voice — ours only when the network is gone): 0, no race — the lab says every line it can; our Space voice only when the lab fails (error, quota), the phone's own voice offline. Before: 16 Oct 2026: when the first two Twi voices are network voices, the first gets ttsHedgeMs to fetch a line; still fetching, the second is asked too and the first audio back is played (recorded lab clips and cached lines play at once). 0 = strictly one after the other.
speech._ttsNote: ghvoice = the app's own on-device Ghanaian-English voice (voice/SherpaTts, assets/models/ondevice/eng/tts/voice.json). A build without that voice has no 'ghvoice' provider and the id is skipped — English is then the phone's engine, as before.

asr._hedgeNote: 29 Oct 2026 (owner): 0 — the HCI Lab hears every Twi turn it can; our Space only when the lab fails. Before: 16 Oct 2026: the first recogniser in a chain gets hedgeMs to answer; still busy, the next is asked beside it and the first answer wins (the lab answers in 4-6 s; that day it timed out at 15 s every turn). 0 = strictly one after the other.

planner._extraNote: P1-15 (R-A6): extra OpenAI-compatible rungs. Each exists at run time only when local.properties has PLANNER_KEY_<ID> (debug builds). A keyed rung joins the chain after the named ones; name it in `chain` to place it earlier. Request-shape fields: toolChoice (some providers accept only auto), parallelToolCalls (false = one tool call per reply where the default is several), reasoningEffort (false for a provider that rejects the field), maxTokensField (max_completion_tokens | max_tokens | empty = none).

extra._note: D-020 (13 Oct 2026): only free sign-ups are in the order; openrouter/openai stay as inert shapes because they need a paid balance.

planner._hedgeNote: N-15 hedge: a Groq call still unanswered after hedgeAfterMs (x1.75 at high effort) is also sent on a fresh connection with the next key; the fallback chain itself (FallbackBrain) checks the link after router.network.watchdogMs of silence instead of racing providers; fallbackHedgeMs is unused. First answer wins, the other is cancelled. 0 = off. A normal step takes 1-2 s.
planner._networkRetryNote: The cloud chain retries once after a network failure only if that failure came within this many ms (a blip); a slower one means a stalled connection and the user is told at once.

guard._note: O-14: separate free-tier quota bucket; used by J-19 (flag off until verified on device)

vision._note: N-06/P-01: camera descriptions; defaults to the Gemini brain model when absent
